modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an immutable run manifest linking GPU identity and enabled SMs to the modified config, script hash, precision, TOPS output and reference comparison.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The script may launch multiple high-power kernels; child process tracking and workload-specific telemetry cadence are required.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently identifies a Hopper PeakTOPs script, NUM_SM=132 and DA/Viking reference; absent provenance and numeric oracle are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool, reference and platform mapping are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Binds the hard-coded SM configuration to real hardware and makes custom-tool performance comparison reproducible and safe.
independent_technical_reasoning: Peak throughput depends on enabled SM count, clock/power state, precision and kernel implementation. A script configured for 132 SMs can underuse or oversubscribe a different Hopper SKU, invalidating comparison without necessarily failing execution. Tool and reference revisions must match because operation counting and reported TOPS may change, while sustained execution requires child-process and thermal/power monitoring.
